chars.A: ADIL: a young Moroccan man of 22 wearing a bright red hooded sweatshirt, light blue ripped jeans, white sneakers and a thin gold chain.
chars.F: FATHER: a rich older Moroccan farm owner wearing a cream-colored traditional djellaba, a dark brown wool flat cap and a small grey mustache.
chars.G: GUARD: an old Moroccan farm guard wearing a long dark green military-style coat, a black wool beanie and black rubber boots, holding a wooden stick.
chars.P: FRIENDS: two young men in black and yellow tracksuits and two young women in colorful party dresses with small handbags.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a dim farmhouse office with a big old green iron safe open on the floor. ADIL kneels and stuffs thick bundles of banknotes into his hoodie pocket, looking nervous over his shoulder, while FATHER stands in the doorway behind him in shadow, arms crossed, glaring suspiciously. Tense atmosphere.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: FATHER alone kneeling at the open old green iron safe in the farmhouse office, counting a thin bundle of banknotes, frowning deeply with a shocked suspicious face, a desk lamp lighting him.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Outside at the farm gate near Settat, Morocco, wheat fields and olive trees behind, a small guard hut. FATHER walks up to GUARD with a serious face, pointing at the ground, GUARD looks surprised and nervous. Afternoon light.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot at the farm guard hut: FATHER leans toward GUARD, questioning him intensely, one finger raised; GUARD scratches his head, hesitant and uncomfortable. Moroccan countryside behind.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Flashback: a black Mercedes car arrives at a farm villa gate at dusk in the Moroccan countryside, ADIL driving and smiling proudly, FRIENDS laughing in the car, music vibe.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: FATHER stands with GUARD at the farm gate, FATHER's face angry and thinking hard, fists clenched, while GUARD looks down at his boots avoiding eye contact. Dramatic evening sky.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night at the farm villa living room with traditional Moroccan sofas: ADIL and FRIENDS dancing and laughing, plates of grilled meat and soda bottles on the low table, colorful lights. Party mood.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night: GUARD hides behind an olive tree near the farm villa, watching the lit windows with a flashlight off, sneaky worried face. Moon in the sky.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: At the farm gate at dusk, FATHER secretly hands GUARD a folded banknote and whispers in his ear with a cold determined face; GUARD nods slowly, serious. Conspiratorial mood.
